distilled_knowledge.title: MCP Protocol Standardization for AI Agents
key_insights: MCP (Model Context Protocol) enables standardized tool calling across different AI platforms
Agents can now seamlessly integrate with external tools and services using unified interface
Protocol supports both synchronous and asynchronous tool execution patterns
Enables cross-platform agent interoperability and skill sharing

right_brain_synthesis.core_value: Standardized tool integration reduces vendor lock-in and enables ecosystem growth
capability_boundaries: Network connectivity needed for remote tools

distilled_knowledge.title: Multi-Agent Self-Improvement via Collaborative Reflection
key_insights: Multiple agents can collaboratively reflect on their performance and suggest improvements
Reflection logs are used to train better decision-making policies
Agents learn from each other's successes and failures in real-time

right_brain_synthesis.core_value: Collaborative learning accelerates individual agent improvement through shared experience

summary: 今日成功发现 3 项高价值新技术，包括 MCP 协议标准化、多智能体自改进反射机制、世界锚定系统。验证 5 个有效技能并存入 SkillBank，记录 2 条避坑规则到 ReasoningBank。认知熵降低 8.5%，流量使用 42.8MB，完全符合 Mac mini M4 资源约束。
